shigureni.name: shigureni free illust
shigureni.summary: Free for use in apps and websites. Resizing, cropping, recolouring and flipping are permitted. Redrawing or tracing a derivative illustration is not, nor is any generative-AI use. Up to 5 illustrations free per production for commercial use; ¥1,000 each thereafter.
shigureni.commercialUse: Nine illustrations are used here for the seats, plus the mascot recorded in ../mascot/manifest.json — ten in all, above the 5 that are free for COMMERCIAL use. Poker Master is a free site with no revenue, so the ceiling does not apply as things stand; if that ever changes, five additional licences are needed — see README.md. The first draft's nine icon files were removed on 2026-09-26 and are no longer in the repository.
